title: BillingEvent
description: An append-only entry in a tenant's simulated billing ledger — the offline model that DRIVES the tenant lifecycle (onboarding -> active -> suspended -> active). NO real money: amount_cents is a modeled charge derived from the plan_tier price book, never a real transaction. The ledger is the tenant's billing audit trail (the operator's /admin/.../billing view); the 'account balance' is a fold over these events (sum of charge minus sum of payment, positive = owed), never a separate materialized aggregate. Events are recorded only by the OnboardingService on a legal, successful lifecycle transition, so the ledger and Tenant.lifecycle_status move together. See product/README.md and ADR 0015.

event_id.description: Stable internal identity, injected from the id generator (never ambient).

tenant_id.description: The tenant this billing event belongs to. The ledger is partitioned by this key; eventsFor(tenant_id) returns ONLY a single tenant's events (no cross-tenant leak).

kind.description: What happened. Financial kinds carry money: 'charge' accrues a plan-tier fee (increases the owed balance), 'payment' settles money in (decreases it). Marker kinds carry NO money and record a lifecycle fact: 'provisioned' (the account was opened, tenant born in onboarding), 'suspended' (delinquency / active->suspended), 'reactivated' (suspended->active). The balance fold sums ONLY the financial kinds.

amount_cents.description: Money as INTEGER CENTS (never a float). Present iff kind is financial ('charge' or 'payment') and forbidden on marker kinds (enforced below by the per-kind allOf), so the balance fold can never accidentally sum a non-financial marker.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the event was recorded, from the injected clock (never ambient).

allOf.description: Per-kind money rule: financial kinds REQUIRE amount_cents; marker kinds FORBID it.
